title: VitalityRealism
description:
Here, the body's processes are influenced in the game (thirst, vitamin D, etc.). There is also a zombie evolution feature.

>:
body:
VitalityRealism – The Ultimate Survival Simulation

VitalityRealism is a comprehensive hardcore survival plugin that transforms Minecraft's simple mechanics into a deep simulation. Your body reacts to the environment, the weather, and your physical exertion. Only those who keep track of their stats will survive the apocalypse.

### Main Features:
Advanced Vitality System (Scoreboard):

Thirst: Water is essential for life! You lose moisture through movement and heat. Soups and drinking directly from bodies of water keep you hydrated.

Stamina: Every action costs energy. Sprinting, swimming, and fighting deplete your stamina bar. Exhaustion makes you slow and weak.

Vitamin D: The sun is your friend. Prolonged stays in dark caves weaken you, while sunlight gives you strength.

Dynamic Zombie Evolution:

Zombies are no longer a simple threat. They evolve every 5 minutes, becoming stronger, faster, or immune to fire.

Infection Risk: If you are hit by undead too often, you will become infected. The only cure? The death of a teammate.

Environmental & Biome Effects:

Temperatures: You dehydrate faster in deserts, while the cold slows you down in ice biomes.

Altitude Sickness: Above 128 blocks, the air becomes thin—your breathing suffers, and you become weak.

Weather Empathy: Dark clouds and thunderstorms affect your mood and your movement speed.

Realistic Crafting & Combat:

Blocks cannot always be mined immediately; tools can be damaged by hard rock.

Your current stamina directly affects your damage output—only a well-rested fighter can land critical hits.
